name: 321. Embeddings on DeepInfra and Vercel AI Gateway custom providers (custom-provider embeddings)
description: Contract C12: MVP embedding models sold through OpenAI-compatible custom providers that the Tokun reconciler writes into Bifrost. The profile entries deepinfra and vercel_ai_gateway are configured as the reconciler writes them: base_provider_type openai, max_retries 0 (C3), allowed_requests embedding only; DeepInfra at https://api.deepinfra.com with request_path_overrides embedding -> /v1/openai/embeddings, Vercel AI Gateway at https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh. Each case sends what Tokun sends (provider/model on /v1/embeddings with x-bf-passthrough-extra-params: true) and pins that usage.prompt_tokens comes through the custom provider as on a built-in one. Keys come from DEEPINFRA_API_KEY and VERCEL_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY; while a key is unset its cases are skipped with a "skipped: no key" assertion (runners/lib/keyless-providers.mjs) instead of failing. Pending: Vercel's single-upstream constraint field is not known yet, so the case proving it reaches Vercel through the extra-field channel is not written; Perplexity's Vercel embedding model id is likewise not pinned here.
